protocol.selection: Cases fixed by names before any enrichment request; seed42 fixed, no result-based selection. All cases are public entity queries, not records from the paper.
protocol.foreground: All selected herbs' observed eligible targets within the 49 shared-target computation universe, mapped using the existing exact STRING mapping
protocol.primary_background: All 49 shared-target candidates, not the human proteome
protocol.secondary_background: STRING default human background; explicitly exploratory sensitivity to background choice
protocol.significance: Report all returned pathway terms including nonsignificant; STRING within-list/category FDR as returned, no claim of correction across query-method-background combinations
limits: Shared sources and diabetes-focused source selection create ascertainment bias
Missing mappings and fewer than 2 targets recorded explicitly
PPI omission may leave the same selected targets and thus identical enrichment
No substitution of coverage ratios for pathway p-values
